description: A 33-byte name (the v1 name followed by one more zero byte) with the A1 payload: not the 32-byte v1 name, so the event is ignored ("any other name").
basis: MIP "Consuming" (78ecbb4): "Some sources drop trailing zero bytes; consumers MUST treat missing trailing bytes as zero, so that every `name` is 32 bytes and every `payload` 256 bytes, before decoding." The expected result is the full form's. Zero extension only adds missing bytes; a longer name is another name (MIP "Event": consumers MUST ignore Misc events with any other name).
